counterevidence: ECI is one composite; open models are often released with a lag that the gap at release date understates; Chinese labs' compute constraints are the confound.

crosswalk.note: Capability growth is the model layer's product; inference price at fixed capability ⇄ price-per-token pass-through; open-weights lag ⇄ open-vs-closed gap.

definition: Gap in Epoch Capabilities Index points between the best closed-weights model and the best open-weights model, measured at each open-weights release. Derived metric open_vs_closed_gap.

direction_rule.rationale: Four open-weights releases; a move under two ECI points is inside the index's confidence intervals. Widening gap = rents concentrating in the closed labs.

evidence.snippet: In early January 2024, the leading closed- weight model outperformed the top open-weight model by 8.04% on the Chatbot Arena Leaderboard. By February 2025, this gap had narrowed to 1.70%.
evidence.summary: AI Index 2025: the best closed model's lead over the best open one on Chatbot Arena fell from 8.04% in January 2024 to 1.70% in February 2025.

name: Open-weights gap to the closed frontier (ECI points)

status_events.author: claude
status_events.reason: The gap fell from 11.5 to 5.8 ECI points with one open-weights release on 16 Jul 2026, then held flat across three more releases. One move in four readings is not a trend under the direction rule, so the reading moves from dispersing to unclear. The earlier reading counted flat steps as agreeing with a fall, an evaluator bug fixed in this change.

status_events.author: evaluate
status_events.reason: Evaluator: 5.77 (Epoch AI benchmarks and Capabilities Index, 2026-08-20) reads dispersing over 4 periods with a dead band of 2. Auto-reason; rule rationale: Four open-weights releases; a move under two ECI points is inside the index's confidence intervals. Widening gap = rents concentrating in the closed labs.

timing_rationale: Leading: open-weights releases close the capability gap before prices and shares in the model layer respond.
tracker_interpretation: Measured on Epoch's composite index, so it follows the benchmarks Epoch runs; a gap in points is not a gap in months.
why_it_matters: Open-weight quality converging on the frontier is the single best leading indicator of model-layer commoditisation; a widening gap says the closed labs keep their rents.
